name: kmop-hq
description: KMOP HQ — project management and management reporting for the KMOP entities.

scripts.db:reset: rm -rf .wrangler/state && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.db:migrate: node scripts/check-migrations.mjs && wrangler d1 migrations apply kmop-hq --local
scripts.check: node scripts/check-migrations.mjs && node scripts/check-schema.mjs && node scripts/check-i18n.mjs
scripts.deploy: npm run check && wrangler d1 migrations apply kmop-hq --remote && wrangler deploy
